scope: native reconstruction gate only; first hash-selected request in each dataset, each checkpoint, prescribed nonterminal boundaries
review_method: Separate CPU reconstruction of trace and boundary checks against authenticated retained artifacts; implementation-author overlap; no independent native rerun.

audit_correction.detail: First CPU audit mistakenly treated the known seed as part of draft_tokens. The unchanged native schema records 15 proposals and 16 verifier/position rows. The auditor was corrected and all checks rerun.

scope_limits: Cache byte comparisons were executed by the native runner; CPU review verifies their receipts and exact downstream traces, not the untransferred tensor payloads.
This gate does not establish full-campaign completion, a positive restart effect, serving speedup or a training mechanism benefit.
Final full work ledger and postflight require a separate completed-campaign audit.
advance_repair_interpretation: All actual first-progress advances remain in the analysis. Verified repair requires matching KPLUS4's first rejected canonical token while keeping preceding matches. An advance without that flag is not a demonstrated repair.
